features.name: agent_auc_log_nonalt_interval
features.rationale: Compress high inter-tap intervals while retaining their interaction with nonalternation.

features.name: agent_auc_nonalt_rate_inverse
features.rationale: Alternative rate-based timescale uses task event count/duration instead of retained interval mean.

features.name: agent_auc_imbalance_interval
features.rationale: Combine left/right event imbalance and tapping slowness without claiming neurological laterality.

features.name: agent_auc_half_change_interval
features.rationale: Signed second-half rate change interacting with slowness; practice and task execution can also cause it.

features.name: agent_auc_nonalt_step
features.rationale: Cross-task interaction of tapping alternation and device-derived step length.
